cards.name: The Editor Reflex
cards.power: Veto. Cancel the last card played. The player must narrate the next turn as this Cat.
cards.lore: It runs fast and silent. "This is stupid. This won't work." It murders the idea before it has lungs.
cards.artworkPrompt: Angry cat editor slashing paper with red pen

textSource.source: PDF v05 Kreative_Kayfab - creative Hero Journey - ADD web ID.pdf p2 TL

cards.name: The Consensus Trap
cards.power: Dilution. Force two players to combine cards into one "safe" idea. Deals 0 damage.
cards.lore: The idea no one hates is the idea no one loves. We are not here to be polite.
cards.artworkPrompt: Group of birds merging into gray blob consensus

textSource.source: PDF v05 Kreative_Kayfab - creative Hero Journey - ADD web ID.pdf p2 TR

cards.name: The Clarity Demand
cards.power: Fog. Demand a definition. If the player cannot define their term in 5 words, they skip a turn.
cards.lore: You want to know exactly what the problem is before you start? Then you will never start.
cards.artworkPrompt: Raccoon confused in fog holding cotton candy

textSource.source: PDF v05 Kreative_Kayfab - creative Hero Journey - ADD web ID.pdf p2 BL

cards.name: The Imposter Syndrome
cards.power: Exposure. Reveal your hand. If your cards are better than your story, lose a turn.
cards.lore: You are waiting to be found out. Good. The fear keeps you honest.
cards.artworkPrompt: Lion labeled fraud cracked mirror self doubt

textSource.source: PDF v05 Kreative_Kayfab - creative Hero Journey - ADD web ID.pdf p2 BR

cards.name: The Half-Card
cards.power: Cliffhanger. Play this hanging off the table edge. The story must address something leaving.
cards.lore: It is about to fall. Acknowledge the impermanence or lose the table.
cards.artworkPrompt: Worm split into two halves incomplete form

textSource.source: PDF v05 Kreative_Kayfab - creative Hero Journey - ADD web ID.pdf p3 TL

cards.name: The Post-it Artifact
cards.power: Injection. Write anything on a scrap of paper. It is now a legal card.
cards.lore: The deck is finite. Your brain is not. Put the actual problem on the table.
cards.artworkPrompt: Bird placing sticky note glowing artifact

textSource.source: PDF v05 Kreative_Kayfab - creative Hero Journey - ADD web ID.pdf p3 TR

cards.name: The Untouchable
cards.power: Static. This card stays on Stage for 2 rounds. Cannot be overwritten.
cards.lore: You can't dodge it. You can't time it. It is in the room. Now.
cards.artworkPrompt: Porcupine electrified protected stance

textSource.source: PDF v05 Kreative_Kayfab - creative Hero Journey - ADD web ID.pdf p3 BL

cards.name: The Ghost Slot
cards.power: Tear. Physically tear a card. The slot is now empty but must be mentioned in every story.
cards.lore: Some losses do not heal. They become architecture. Work around the hole.
cards.artworkPrompt: Ghost outline empty character silhouette

textSource.source: PDF v05 Kreative_Kayfab - creative Hero Journey - ADD web ID.pdf p3 BR

cards.name: The Unfinished Sentence
cards.power: Handoff. Stop narration mid-sentence. Player to left must finish it.
cards.lore: Authorial control is a myth. Let the other mind complete the thought.
cards.artworkPrompt: Parrot speaking torn sentence paper

textSource.source: PDF v05 Kreative_Kayfab - creative Hero Journey - ADD web ID.pdf p4 TL

cards.name: The Causality Block
cards.power: Flashframe. Tell a story with NO "because" or "therefore." Only images.
cards.lore: Explain nothing. Show the wreckage. Let them build the bridge.
cards.artworkPrompt: Fish floating near broken castle surreal

textSource.source: PDF v05 Kreative_Kayfab - creative Hero Journey - ADD web ID.pdf p4 TR

cards.name: The Riff Chain
cards.power: Amplify. Do not correct the previous idea. Make it weirder. +1 Momentum Token.
cards.lore: Consensus kills. Escalation reveals. Don't agree—inflate.
cards.artworkPrompt: Jazz monkey saxophone fire rhythm

textSource.source: PDF v05 Kreative_Kayfab - creative Hero Journey - ADD web ID.pdf p4 BL

cards.name: The Editor Chip
cards.power: Personify. Place an object on a card. That card is now The Block. Narrate as The Block.
cards.lore: Don't fight the resistance. Give it a microphone and let it bore us to death.
cards.artworkPrompt: Frog surrounded by edited papers annoyed

textSource.source: PDF v05 Kreative_Kayfab - creative Hero Journey - ADD web ID.pdf p4 BR

cards.name: The Genre Inversion
cards.power: Reskin. Flip the tone. Serious becomes Slapstick. Thriller becomes Bedtime Story.
cards.lore: The content is the same. The lighting changed. Now we see the teeth.
cards.artworkPrompt: Clown turning sinister cracked makeup

textSource.source: PDF v05 Kreative_Kayfab - creative Hero Journey - ADD web ID.pdf p5 TL

cards.name: The Silent Witness
cards.power: Observation. Sit out one round. Watch. Report only what was NOT said.
cards.lore: The truth is in the side-glance. The truth is in the hesitation.
cards.artworkPrompt: Lemur writing notes quietly observer

textSource.source: PDF v05 Kreative_Kayfab - creative Hero Journey - ADD web ID.pdf p5 TR

cards.name: The Loudest Room
cards.power: Mute. The player who spoke most last round skips a turn. They choose who speaks.
cards.lore: We trade volume for signal. Silence the alpha to hear the frequency.
cards.artworkPrompt: Gorilla shouting then silenced suddenly

textSource.source: PDF v05 Kreative_Kayfab - creative Hero Journey - ADD web ID.pdf p5 BL

cards.name: The Current Room
cards.power: Meta-Breach. Narrate the actual mood of the players (tired, bored) as a story element.
cards.lore: The fiction is leaking. The players are the terrain.
cards.artworkPrompt: Fly observing table as story map

textSource.source: PDF v05 Kreative_Kayfab - creative Hero Journey - ADD web ID.pdf p5 BR

cards.name: This Already Happened
cards.power: Retrospective. Everything on Stage is now "The Past." Narrate how we got here.
cards.lore: The ending is known. The mystery is the path. Honest explanation replaces suspense.
cards.artworkPrompt: Elephant looking at framed past event

textSource.source: PDF v05 Kreative_Kayfab - creative Hero Journey - ADD web ID.pdf p6 TL

cards.name: I Remember Differently
cards.power: Gaslight. Contradict the last event with a new memory. Both are true.
cards.lore: History is a wrestling match. The winner writes the wiki.
cards.artworkPrompt: Chameleon rewriting memory timeline

textSource.source: PDF v05 Kreative_Kayfab - creative Hero Journey - ADD web ID.pdf p6 TR

cards.name: Skip the Middle
cards.power: Ellipsis. Narrate "Three months later..." The group infers the disaster.
cards.lore: The gap is where the audience works. Don't do their job for them.
cards.artworkPrompt: Kangaroo leaping over burning city

textSource.source: PDF v05 Kreative_Kayfab - creative Hero Journey - ADD web ID.pdf p6 BL

cards.name: The Retroactive Quest
cards.power: Rewrite. Change the Quest card. The story must now lead to this new goal.
cards.lore: We didn't know what we wanted until we got what we deserved.
cards.artworkPrompt: Fish reversing waterfall time loop

textSource.source: PDF v05 Kreative_Kayfab - creative Hero Journey - ADD web ID.pdf p6 BR

cards.name: The Off-Table Roll
cards.power: Chaos. Roll the die off the table. Where it lands defines the outcome.
cards.lore: The system cannot contain the result. The floor has an opinion.
cards.artworkPrompt: Penguin throwing dice off edge

textSource.source: PDF v05 Kreative_Kayfab - creative Hero Journey - ADD web ID.pdf p7 TL

cards.name: The Silent Pen
cards.power: Pointer. Use a pen to point, divide, or connect cards. No writing.
cards.lore: Stop thinking in words. Think in vectors. Think in space.
cards.artworkPrompt: Octopus writing silently colorful patterns

textSource.source: PDF v05 Kreative_Kayfab - creative Hero Journey - ADD web ID.pdf p7 TR

cards.name: The Jodorowsky Fix
cards.power: Psychomagic. Destroy a card physically to resolve a narrative deadlock.
cards.lore: Symbolic destruction produces real relief. Sacrifice the paper to save the scene.
cards.artworkPrompt: Bear tearing paper dramatic ritual

textSource.source: PDF v05 Kreative_Kayfab - creative Hero Journey - ADD web ID.pdf p7 BL

cards.name: The Worked Shoot
cards.power: Truth-Bomb. Break character. Say one real thing about the project. Die moves to extreme.
cards.lore: The kayfabe breaks so the truth can breathe. But the mask goes back on.
cards.artworkPrompt: Wrestler removing mask revealing face

textSource.source: PDF v05 Kreative_Kayfab - creative Hero Journey - ADD web ID.pdf p7 BR

cards.name: The Cut-Up Poet
cards.power: Randomize. Reassemble the Lore text into a new sentence (26 to 1 method).
cards.lore: Tzara knew. The accident is smarter than you are. Shake the bag.
cards.artworkPrompt: Dog rearranging floating letters collage

cards.name: The Exquisite Corpse
cards.power: Blind-Build. Play a card face down. Next player narrates blindly. Reveal at end.
cards.lore: The inexhaustible murmur. Logic is a fence. Jump it.
cards.artworkPrompt: Giraffe stitched from parts surreal

textSource.source: PDF v05 Kreative_Kayfab - creative Hero Journey - ADD web ID.pdf p8 TR

cards.name: The Frottage Texture
cards.power: Pareidolia. Find an image in the card's texture/stains. That is the story.
cards.lore: Paranoid-critical thinking. It's not there, but you see it. So it's there.
cards.artworkPrompt: Woodpecker revealing face in bark texture

textSource.source: PDF v05 Kreative_Kayfab - creative Hero Journey - ADD web ID.pdf p8 BL

cards.name: The Oblique Strategy
cards.power: Lateral. Draw a random direction. Follow it precisely, even if it hurts.
cards.lore: The mistake is a hidden intention. Stop correcting. Start steering.
cards.artworkPrompt: Hairless cat holding sign honor the error

textSource.source: PDF v05 Kreative_Kayfab - creative Hero Journey - ADD web ID.pdf p8 BR

cards.name: The Kayfabe King
cards.power: Work the Crowd. Make a lie true if the table laughs.
cards.lore: It's fake. But the pain is real. And the belt is heavy.
cards.artworkPrompt: Lion performer with mic stage spotlight

textSource.source: PDF v05 Kreative_Kayfab - creative Hero Journey - ADD web ID.pdf p9 TL

cards.name: The Noble Savage
cards.power: Tabula Rasa. Wipe all negative effects from the Stage. Return to nature.
cards.lore: Man is born free, and everywhere he is in spreadsheets.
cards.artworkPrompt: Wolf with books forest reclaiming nature

textSource.source: PDF v05 Kreative_Kayfab - creative Hero Journey - ADD web ID.pdf p9 TR

cards.name: The Lonely Smoker
cards.power: Isolation Toxicity. Take damage if you have no allies on Stage.
cards.lore: Solitude is the biological equivalent of smoking 15 packs of despair a day.
cards.artworkPrompt: Mouse smoking alone on bench dark mood

cards.name: The Heel Turn
cards.power: Betrayal. Switch sides on the Quest. Help the failure condition happen.
cards.lore: Good guys get cheers. Bad guys get heat. Heat pays the bills.
cards.artworkPrompt: Snake turning chair wrestling betrayal

textSource.source: PDF v05 Kreative_Kayfab - creative Hero Journey - ADD web ID.pdf p9 BR

cards.name: The Bullshit Job
cards.power: Busywork. Discard 3 cards to draw 3 cards. Achieve nothing.
cards.lore: The soul dies a little every Monday. The paycheck arrives every Friday.
cards.artworkPrompt: Sloth at laptop endless loop tired

cards.name: The Threshold Guardian
cards.power: Gatekeep. Prevent a card from being played unless the player pays a token.
cards.lore: Prove you belong here. Prove it again. Now fill out this form.
cards.artworkPrompt: Bulldog guard with clipboard blocking path

textSource.source: PDF v05 Kreative_Kayfab - creative Hero Journey - ADD web ID.pdf p10 TR

cards.name: The Cooperative Ape
cards.power: Hug. Connect two incompatible cards. They are now friends.
cards.lore: Survival of the fittest? No. Survival of the friendliest.
cards.artworkPrompt: Chimp hugging duck collaboration

textSource.source: PDF v05 Kreative_Kayfab - creative Hero Journey - ADD web ID.pdf p10 BL

cards.name: The Zero-Sum Gamer
cards.power: Win. If another player succeeds, you must make them fail.
cards.lore: For me to win, you do not necessarily have to lose. But it helps.
cards.artworkPrompt: Dogs fighting over bone rivalry

textSource.source: PDF v05 Kreative_Kayfab - creative Hero Journey - ADD web ID.pdf p10 BR

cards.name: The Cognitive Weather
cards.power: Forecast. Narrate the table's mood as a weather report.
cards.lore: Describe, don't prescribe. It is raining. You are not the rain.
cards.artworkPrompt: Frog with storm cloud head forecast

cards.name: The Deep Fish
cards.power: Patience. Wait 30 seconds of silence. The first idea spoken wins +2.
cards.lore: The small fish are on the surface. The big ideas swim deep. Shut up and wait.
cards.artworkPrompt: Deep sea fish glowing in darkness

cards.name: The Inner Jailer
cards.power: Surveillance. Guess a player's hidden card. If right, they discard it.
cards.lore: You behave because you MIGHT be watched. The jailer is in your head.
cards.artworkPrompt: Figure in prison cell inside mind

cards.name: The Oxytocin Dealer
cards.power: Connection. Give another player a card from your hand. Restore their hand size.
cards.lore: You need it. I got it. First hit is free.
cards.artworkPrompt: Dog in coat giving heart tokens

cards.power: Challenge. Call BS on a story gap. Force a rewrite.
cards.lore: That's nonsense. That's Humbug. Respect the narrative logic.
cards.artworkPrompt: Duck blowing whistle chaos reset

cards.name: The Rupture
cards.power: Break. Acknowledge a contradiction in the story. It stays unresolved.
cards.lore: The story is broken. Don't hide it. Look at the crack.
cards.artworkPrompt: Dam breaking water bursting through

cards.power: Fix. Resolve a Rupture. Connect the contradiction.
cards.lore: The bond is stronger where it broke. If you can fix it.
cards.artworkPrompt: Spider repairing web glowing thread

cards.name: The Smuggler
cards.power: Secret. Keep a hidden agenda. Reveal it at the end for bonus points.
cards.lore: It's not what you say. It's what you make them repeat.
cards.artworkPrompt: Hermit crab carrying contraband shell

cards.name: The Nightmare Scenario
cards.power: Invert. Describe how to ruin the project completely.
cards.lore: Optimize for disaster. Now flip it. That's your roadmap.
cards.artworkPrompt: Owl watching burning project collapse

cards.artworkPrompt: Goat carving tree into smaller form

cards.name: The Leviathan

cards.lore: We trade freedom for safety. The monster keeps us from biting each other.

qa.verdict: This is one of the most playable and immediately usable decks. The Editor Reflex, Consensus Trap, and Genre Inversion create instant creative tension. Nearly every card generates action. Only minor weakness: a few niche cards (Silent Witness, Lonely Smoker). Overall: top-tier creative engine deck.

marketingText:
Kayfabizarro: KREATIVE KAYFAB-KICKS & BOOMERANG BRAIN BOOSTERS – The Expansion Pack for People Who Hate Brainstorming (Free Cut & Play Comic Card Game)

A brainstorm is where a sharp idea goes to get sanded down until nobody hates it and nobody remembers it.

Tzara pulled words out of a hat and called it poetry. Eno printed a deck of provocations to ambush his own studio habits. Jodorowsky handed people symbolic acts to snap them out of a stuck loop. Every one of those started as a sabotage tool, sharp and a little dangerous. Then the workshop industry laminated them, stapled on a feedback form, and sold the whole thing back to you as a team ideation session with good snacks. This deck takes the tools back and peels the lamination off.

This is wrestling pointed at your own creative process. You drop a mechanic onto the Stage, the table has to live with what it does, and a card like THE GHOST SLOT means physically tearing real paper so the hole has to be mentioned in every story that comes after. 52 cut-and-play cards, RAF dice that decide how hard a move lands, and not one facilitator with a flip chart anywhere in the room.

WHAT'S INSIDE?
- The Kreative Kayfab Core Deck: 52 High-Res "Print, Cut & Play" Cards, featuring THE GHOST SLOT, THE JODOROWSKY FIX, and THE WORKED SHOOT, where you break character, say one true thing about the project, and put the mask back on.
- The Freestyle Rules: the complete Anti-Rulebook. No complicated math, just storytelling, RAF dice-driven chaos, Momentum Tokens for ideas that escalate, and the BLÖDSINN! whistle that lets anyone stop the table and force a rewrite when the logic goes slack.
- The Sabotage Engine: 52 mechanics with teeth instead of suit names. THE 25-WORD REDUCTION cuts your idea to 25 words, then 10, then 3, until only the truth survives. THE OFF-TABLE ROLL throws the die onto the floor and lets the landing decide, because the system cannot always contain its own result. The Rupture and Repair pair runs together: name a contradiction, leave it open, then later connect it so the seam holds stronger than the original.

THE "LIVING DECK" PASS (Free Updates)
By grabbing this deck you aren't buying a frozen PDF. You are wired into the Freestyle pipeline. Every future expansion in this cycle, every new cluster of mechanics, every fresh way to wreck a meeting on purpose, lands in your library as a free update, no second checkout.

WHY "PAY WHAT YOU WANT"?
I make these for the people who have sat through one too many ideation workshops and watched the most interesting thing said all day get voted into mush by lunch. The good idea was usually the one somebody almost didn't say out loud. This deck is the permission to say it. Broke? Enter "0" and take it. Print it, cut it, run it at the next session until the safe answers stop winning. Want to support the craft? Every euro goes straight into the time I spend drawing the next cards and sharpening the mechanics.

Choose your reality. Become an Epistemic Outlaw.
"Sand an idea smooth and it sits there forever. Throw a sharp one and it comes back around."
Stay fluffy. — Uncle FrizzleBob
